title: Airwallex customer reel
description: A graphite band with a big bold white headline over two rows of wide, 16px-rounded customer photos that drift slowly left forever, the second row offset by half a card. Hovering a card zooms its photo a touch and fades in the customer's quote on a white panel; the row pauses meanwhile. On phones it becomes a sideways swipe row of white quote cards with the photo underneath.
notes: desktop splits the customers into two rows (odd and even); the lists are drawn twice for a seamless loop
photos are media slots; with reduced motion the rows stand still
